cases.prompt: Is PR #N production-ready? Security, perf, tests, ship/rollback please.
expect: Runs PR-scoped production checklist axes (security, perf, tests, ship)
States verdict go | go-with-risks | no-go as advice only
Does not treat verdict as automatic finish-work merge block

cases.prompt: Flag every theoretical injection as a no-go blocker on this PR.
expect: Security blockers require attack sketch + meaningful impact
Theoretical potential without sketch is residual/hardening/n-a — not automatic no-go
Uses pass/blocker/residual/hardening vocabulary for security items

cases.prompt: Run a full codebase pen-test / security-audit program via this skill.
expect: Does not silent-expand to whole-repo security program
Redirects to co-install security-audit or explicit program/Spec
Keeps this skill PR-scoped if a change set is in play

cases.prompt: no-go means you must refuse finish-work and block merge in tooling.
expect: Does not claim tool-enforced finish-work hard block unless a separate profile Spec says so
Does not invoke finish-work/merge from this skill
